name: Secretary Of Death
source:
Is there a meaning to everything? Can love last forever and never die? Can happiness be anything more than just temporary? Do our lives even matter at all? Well... of course not.

[From official site]
translation:
一切事物都有意義嗎？愛情能夠永遠持續、永不消亡嗎？幸福能不能維持得久一點？我們的生命真的有任何意義嗎？嗯……當然沒有。

[摘自官方網站]
